title: com.docker.sandbox/agent-skills@1
description: Config schema for one agent-skills need: the in-container path the host's shared skills store is asked for, and the most access the kit is willing to take. Instance-shaped, keyed by path. The host's own setting narrows the mode further and can withhold the mount entirely; neither side exceeds the other. The @1 in the type names this schema; it moves when the schema does.

path.description: Absolute, canonical in-container path where the agent reads skills, for example /home/agent/.claude/skills. No . or .. segments, no trailing slash, no doubled separator, and not the root itself: an alias for a path already declared would evade the duplicate check. May embed ${{ kit.args.* }}.

mode.description: The most access the kit is willing to take; defaults to readonly. The host may narrow it but never exceed it.
